---
title: "Glossary"
---

::: {.lead}
Short definitions of the terms used in SysNDD, in this documentation and in the SysNDD
publication. Each entry links to the page that explains the term in full.
:::

::: {.callout-note .who-can title="Who this is for"}
Everyone.
:::

The terms follow the SysNDD publication [@popp_sysndd_2026]. Where the web app uses a different
label, the label is given in **bold**. Evidence-category rules are defined only in
[Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd); the entries here name the categories and link
there.

[A](#a) · [C](#c) · [D](#d) · [E](#e) · [F](#f) · [G](#g) · [H](#h) · [I](#i) · [J](#j) ·
[L](#l) · [M](#m) · [N](#n) · [O](#o) · [P](#p) · [R](#r) · [S](#s) · [V](#v)

## A

Active record
: The review or status that is currently shown for an entity. Each entity has one active review
  and one active status; earlier ones are kept. See [Data model](04-database-structure.qmd).

Administrator
: The account role with full access, including user management and the **Administration** menu.
  Written [Administrator]{.role} in this documentation.

Analysis-snapshot release
: A fixed, published export of the derived analyses (functional clusters, phenotype clusters and
  their correlation), listed under **Analyses › Data releases**. It does not change after
  publication. See [Cite SysNDD and reuse its data](reference-citing.qmd).

API (application programming interface)
: The web address that returns SysNDD data to scripts and programs instead of web pages. See
  [Get SysNDD data with the API and MCP](03-api.qmd).

Approval, approve
: The step in which a Curator or Administrator makes a submitted review or status active and
  public. Nothing a Reviewer submits is public before approval.

## C

CC BY 4.0
: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, the license of SysNDD data. You may reuse the
  data if you give credit. See [Cite SysNDD and reuse its data](reference-citing.qmd).

Clinical synopsis
: The short free-text summary of the evidence and clinical picture of an entity, part of its
  review. Shown as **Clinical Synopsis** on the entity page.

Curation comparison
: A comparison of SysNDD's gene content with other NDD gene resources, such as Gene2Phenotype,
  PanelApp and SFARI. Shown under **Analyses › Compare curations**. See
  [Read the analyses](using-analyses.qmd).

Curator
: The account role that creates and modifies entities, approves reviews and statuses, approves
  new users and manages re-review. Written [Curator]{.role}. With a lowercase "c", "curator"
  means any person who curates.

## D

Deactivate
: To withdraw a duplicate or superseded entity from public views; a Curator can link it to its replacement.
  Entities are never deleted.

Definitive
: The evidence category for an established NDD gene-disease association. Written
  [Definitive]{.cat .cat-definitive}; called "Category 1" in older material. See
  [Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd).

Disease
: The disorder named in an entity, identified by an OMIM number, or by a MONDO identifier where
  OMIM has no entry.

## E

Entity
: The unit of curation in SysNDD: one gene, one mode of inheritance and one disease. Its three
  parts never change once it is created. One gene can have several entities. See
  [Data model](04-database-structure.qmd).

Entity ID
: The number that identifies an entity, such as `856`. The web app shows it with the prefix
  `sysndd:`, as in **sysndd:856**. See [Data model](04-database-structure.qmd).

ERN-ITHACA
: The European Reference Network for Rare Malformation Syndromes, Intellectual and Other
  Neurodevelopmental Disorders. Its experts re-review SysNDD entities.

Evidence category
: The strength of the evidence for an entity's gene-disease association: Definitive, Moderate,
  Limited or Refuted. Not applicable is not an evidence category. See
  [Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd).

## F

Functional cluster
: A group of NDD genes whose proteins interact closely, computed from a protein interaction
  network. A derived analysis and a hypothesis, not a curated fact. Shown under
  **Analyses › Functional clusters**.

## G

Gene-disease association
: The biological relationship that an entity asserts: variants in the gene cause the disease.

GeneReviews
: Expert-written disease chapters on the NCBI Bookshelf. SysNDD lists linked chapters
  separately on the entity page as **Gene Reviews**.

GeneReviews coverage
: The Curator page **Curation › GeneReviews coverage** that shows which entities have, or still
  lack, a linked GeneReviews chapter. See
  [GeneReviews coverage and variation suggestions](curator-genereviews-variation.qmd).

## H

HGNC (HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee)
: The authority for human gene symbols and identifiers, such as *CHD8* and `HGNC:20153`. SysNDD
  identifies every gene by its HGNC ID.

HPO (Human Phenotype Ontology)
: The standard vocabulary for clinical features. SysNDD uses HPO terms for phenotypes, such as
  Macrocephaly (`HP:0000256`), and for modes of inheritance, such as Autosomal dominant
  inheritance (`HP:0000006`).

## I

Inheritance group
: One of the four groups that panels and filters use to bundle the HPO inheritance terms:
  Autosomal dominant, Autosomal recessive, X-linked and Other. See
  [Data model](04-database-structure.qmd#modes-of-inheritance).

## J

JSON (JavaScript Object Notation)
: The plain-text data format in which the API returns its answers. See
  [Get SysNDD data with the API and MCP](03-api.qmd).

JWT (JSON Web Token), token
: A signed string that proves who you are to the API after you sign in. Send it with each request
  to a protected endpoint; it expires after a set time. See
  [Get SysNDD data with the API and MCP](03-api.qmd#sign-in-for-protected-endpoints).

## L

Limited
: The evidence category for a published association with limited genetic and/or clinical
  evidence. Written
  [Limited]{.cat .cat-limited}; called "Category 3" in older material. See
  [Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd).

## M

MCP (Model Context Protocol)
: An open protocol that lets AI assistants call external tools. The SysNDD MCP server gives
  assistants read-only access to approved, public SysNDD data. See
  [Get SysNDD data with the API and MCP](03-api.qmd).

Mode of inheritance
: How a disease is passed on, such as autosomal dominant or X-linked recessive, recorded as an
  HPO term. Shortened to "inheritance" in the app.

Moderate
: The evidence category between Limited and Definitive. Written [Moderate]{.cat .cat-moderate};
  called "Category 2" in older material. See [Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd).

Modifier
: A qualifier on a phenotype or variation term: present, uncertain, variable, rare or absent.
  Variation terms use only present and absent. See [Data model](04-database-structure.qmd).

MONDO (Mondo Disease Ontology)
: A disease ontology that unifies other disease vocabularies. SysNDD uses a MONDO ID when a
  disease has no OMIM entry.

## N

NDD (neurodevelopmental disorder)
: A disorder of brain development. In SysNDD an NDD involves early-onset developmental delay or
  cognitive impairment, early regression, or cognitive impairment in a significant fraction of
  affected individuals; the exact scope is in
  [Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd#definitions).

NDD phenotype
: Whether an entity's disease is a neurodevelopmental disorder (yes or no). Shown as **NDD Yes**
  or **NDD No** on the entity page.

NDDScore
: A machine-learning prediction of how likely a gene is to be an NDD gene. It is separate from
  curated evidence and is not an evidence category. Shown under the **NDDScore** menu with its
  **Model card**.

Not applicable
: The tag for an entity kept for gene context whose disease is outside the NDD scope. It is not
  an evidence category and not a lower tier. Written [Not applicable]{.cat .cat-na}; the app
  writes `not applicable`, and the curation criteria abbreviate it `n.a.`. See [Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd).

## O

OMIM (Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man)
: The catalog of human genes and genetic disorders. SysNDD uses OMIM numbers, such as
  `OMIM:615032`, as the primary disease identifiers.

OpenAPI
: A standard, machine-readable format for describing an API. The SysNDD API publishes its
  OpenAPI description, which the Swagger page displays. See
  [Get SysNDD data with the API and MCP](03-api.qmd).

## P

Panel
: A list of genes filtered by evidence category and mode of inheritance, from
  **Tables › Panels**. See [Build a gene panel](using-panels.qmd).

Phenotype
: A clinical feature annotated on an entity as an HPO term with a modifier.

Phenotype category
: One of the HPO-based groups of phenotypes used in the **Phenotypes** table and in the analyses.

Phenotype cluster
: A group of entities with similar phenotype annotations, computed from the curated data. A
  derived analysis and a hypothesis, not a curated fact. See
  [Read the analyses](using-analyses.qmd).

PMID (PubMed identifier)
: The number of an article in PubMed, written `PMID:` plus the number.

Public
: Anyone using SysNDD without logging in. All approved data are public.

## R

Re-review
: The systematic reassessment of existing entities by Reviewers. Its result is a new review and
  status that a Curator approves. See [Re-review instructions](06-re-review-instructions.qmd).

Refuse (needs specialist)
: A Reviewer hands a re-review back because it is too complex or outside their expertise. The
  item is flagged for specialist or Curator attention. A refused re-review is neither approved
  nor rejected and does not change the entity's category. Use the flag button
  **Refuse / decline (needs specialist)** in the re-review queue, then confirm with
  **Refuse (needs specialist)**.

Refuted
: The evidence category for an association that evidence argues against. Written
  [Refuted]{.cat .cat-refuted}. See [Curation criteria](05-curation-criteria.qmd).

Review
: The curated description of an entity: clinical synopsis, phenotypes, variation and
  publications. Each new review is kept; one is active. See
  [Data model](04-database-structure.qmd).

Reviewer
: The account role that re-reviews assigned entities and submits reviews and statuses for
  approval. Written [Reviewer]{.role}.

## S

Status
: The evidence-category record of an entity, with its date and approval state. Each new status
  is kept; one is active.

Swagger
: The interactive web page that lists every SysNDD API endpoint and lets you send test requests
  from the browser. See [Get SysNDD data with the API and MCP](03-api.qmd#explore-all-endpoints-in-swagger).

Syndromic
: An entity is called syndromic when at least one organ system outside the nervous system is
  recorded as present among its phenotypes.

SysID
: The predecessor database of SysNDD, published in 2016 [@kochinke_systematic_2016].

## V

Variation, VariO
: The Variation Ontology (VariO) describes types and effects of variants, such as protein
  truncation (`VariO:0015`). SysNDD records VariO terms on each entity, shown as
  **Variation Ontology** on the entity page.

Variation suggestions
: Variation Ontology terms imported from external sources such as ClinVar and not yet confirmed
  by a curator. Curators review them under **Curation › Variation suggestions**. See
  [GeneReviews coverage and variation suggestions](curator-genereviews-variation.qmd).

Viewer
: A read-only account role. A Viewer cannot submit, review or approve changes.
